title: Authentication System & Multi-Tenant Architecture Setup
description: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) and establish multi-tenant PostgreSQL architecture with schema isolation
details: Set up Node.js/Express backend with JWT authentication middleware supporting Super Admin, Admin, and Technician roles. Create PostgreSQL database with multi-tenant schema isolation strategy. Implement user management endpoints for CRUD operations, password reset functionality, and session handling. Set up environment configuration for JWT secrets, database connections, and security policies. Create database migration scripts for user tables, roles, and tenant schemas. Implement middleware for tenant context switching and data isolation validation.
test_strategy: Unit tests for authentication middleware, integration tests for user CRUD operations, security tests for JWT token validation and expiration, multi-tenant data isolation tests to ensure no cross-tenant data leakage

title: Customer Management & MikroTik Integration
description: Build customer CRUD system with automated PPPoE provisioning through MikroTik RouterOS v7 REST API integration
details: Create customer data models and API endpoints for full CRUD operations. Implement MikroTik RouterOS v7 REST API client with authentication, error handling, and rate limiting. Build PPPoE secret management functions for create, update, disable operations and rate limit configurations. Implement background sync service to poll PPPoE connection status with configurable intervals. Create service plan (package) management system with rate limit mappings. Add request queuing and exponential backoff for API rate limit mitigation. Implement data validation for customer records and MikroTik API responses.
test_strategy: Unit tests for MikroTik API client, integration tests with mock RouterOS endpoints, end-to-end tests for customer provisioning workflow, performance tests for background sync operations, error handling tests for network failures

title: Interactive Map & Support Ticketing System
description: Develop geographic customer monitoring with Leaflet.js/OpenStreetMap and comprehensive support ticketing module
details: Integrate Leaflet.js with OpenStreetMap tiles for interactive customer mapping. Implement color-coded status markers (Active, Inactive, Disabled) with customer pop-ups showing details and quick actions. Build filtering system by status, plan, and name search. Create technician-specific map views showing only assigned customers. Develop support ticketing system with lifecycle management (Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed), categorization, and admin assignment features. Build technician dashboard with individual KPIs (response time, resolution time). Implement audit logging for ticket status changes and user actions. Add real-time updates for map markers based on PPPoE status sync.
test_strategy: Frontend component tests for map interactions, API tests for ticket CRUD operations, integration tests for map data updates, performance tests for large customer datasets on map, user experience tests for mobile responsiveness

title: Financial Management & Reporting System
description: Build comprehensive financial tracking with custom categories, transaction logging, and automated report generation
details: Create dynamic income and expense category management system. Implement transaction logging interface with date ranges, category filtering, and bulk operations. Build Profit & Loss and Cash Flow report generators with customizable date ranges and category breakdowns. Implement CSV/PDF export functionality using libraries like fast-csv and pdfkit. Create audit trail system for exported reports and financial data changes. Develop executive dashboard with key financial KPIs (Monthly Recurring Revenue, expenses, profit margins). Build custom report builder with drag-and-drop metrics, grouping options, and multiple chart types. Implement report scheduling and automated generation features.
test_strategy: Unit tests for financial calculations, integration tests for report generation, PDF/CSV export validation tests, performance tests for large transaction datasets, accuracy tests for financial formulas and aggregations

title: PWA Frontend & Integration Services
description: Develop React-based Progressive Web App with Xendit payment integration, Telegram notifications, and CSV import functionality
details: Build React frontend with hooks and context API for state management. Implement Progressive Web App features including service workers, offline capabilities, and mobile-first responsive design. Integrate Xendit payment gateway for subscription tier management (Basic, Standard, Premium) with embedded payment widgets. Develop Telegram Bot API integration for critical event notifications and account updates. Create CSV import system with schema validation for customers, tickets, and financial data. Implement comprehensive error handling with user-friendly messages. Build audit log interface for tracking all significant user actions. Add WCAG AA accessibility compliance for forms and dashboards. Implement tier-based feature gating and subscription management interface.
test_strategy: Component tests for React UI, PWA functionality tests across browsers, payment integration tests with Xendit sandbox, Telegram notification delivery tests, CSV import validation tests with malformed data, accessibility compliance tests, cross-browser compatibility tests
